title: Cartesian projection for a restricted tail
statement:
theorem perfectOverlapTailStageProjection
    {X Y S C : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) (pX : X ⟶ C)
    (pY : Y ⟶ S) (b : C ⟶ S) (hg : IsPullback g pX pY b)
    (U V L : Y.Opens) (hWL : U ⊓ V ≤ L) :
    ((isPullback_morphismRestrict g (U ⊓ V)).paste_vert hg).isoPullback.inv ≫
        (X.homOfLE (fun _ hx ↦ hWL hx) ≫ (g ∣_ L)) =
      pullback.fst ((U ⊓ V).ι ≫ pY) b ≫ Y.homOfLE hWL

proof.text: Cancel the inclusion of L to commute restriction with inclusion. Apply the inverse-first-projection equation of the pasted cartesian square.
